g.text: So. How many of you are there?
Just me and the kid that I know of.
You've been inside my head. I guess I'm curious to know more about what's going on inside yours.
At the rate my life is going? Duplicates would be pretty mundane, honestly.
Who knows how many more universes there could be out there?
Technically, I'm not in your head.
You sure? It can get strange in here.
Picture it. Drifters, as far as the eye can see...
More versions of you? Me? Us?
Have you met my sister? You've got nothing on her.
Maybe I'd finally get my laundry folded.
Can you imagine the arguing? And the sass?
I don't know, I think it'd be pretty awesome.
Nope. Still weird, and I still hate it when you say it.
Considering what she's been through? I think she has the right to be "strange."
Maybe there's one where we're dating...
If it makes you feel better, I bet there's at least *one* where you won the fight. :P
Raise one for all the Alternate Arthurs and Different Drifters.
Anyway. Seriously, how many of you *are* there?
She was only marginally more normal when we were children.
To be fair, I'm not sure I'd want to deal with a room full of Arthurs.
Why, fantasizing about two of me? ;)
All of us, glowering at each other in silence. Brooding.
We'd at least get things done, I suppose.
Well, let's just hope we don't end up with Infinite Laundry, yeah?
Bad enough we have to deal with Quincy's stinking up the joint...
You could open up an amazing series of restaurants. ...Sans the square spaghetti, of course.
Grumpy but effective. There are worse ways to be.
All fighting over who lost whose Tommy keys...
You will never let me live that down, will you?
Someday. Today is not that day. ;)
Nope. It still haunts my nightmares.
